patterns: Core facts asked directly: Milindapanha = Menander-Nagasena dialogue; Bactria in north Afghanistan; Sankarshana-Vasudeva coins = Agathocles.
Chronology of invaders (Greeks - Sakas - Kushanas) is a repeated order question.
Coin traps: Indo-Greeks first gold coins vs Kushanas largest gold/copper issues; military governorship first by Greeks.
Site trivia (16 Menander coins at Bairat) appears in state PSCs.
App MCQs cover the same core but use many multi-statement items; APPSC itself asks almost nothing direct on this topic.
